mapper.select: select id userId, tel_no telNo, im_id imId from corgi_user_login where tel_no = #{telNo} limit 1
select id userId, tel_no telNo, im_id imId, new_gidar newGidar, new_sign_up newSignUp, new_message newMessage, new_follow_activity newFollowActivity from corgi_user_login where id = #{userId}
mapper.update:
update corgi_user_login
new_gidar = #{userLogin.newGidar},
new_sign_up = #{userLogin.newSignUp},
new_message = #{userLogin.newMessage},
new_follow_activity = #{userLogin.newFollowActivity},
im_id = #{userLogin.imId},
where id = #{userLogin.userId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from corgi_user_detail where user_id = #{userId}

select d.`user_id` userId, `nickname`, `avatar`, avatar_status avatarStatus, `height`, `weight`, `desc`, `role`, `hide_role`, `character`, `group`, `hide_group`, `birthday`, `con`, `relation`, `city`, l.im_id imId, l.tel_no telNo, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, `check_status` checkStatus from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = d.user_id left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = d.user_id where d.user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from corgi_user_detail where birthday >= #{beginDate} and birthday < #{endDate}

select count(1) from corgi_user_detail
where (`nickname` = #{nickname} or `check_nickname` = #{nickname})
where (`nickname` = #{checkNickname} or `check_nickname` = #{checkNickname})
and user_id != #{userId}
select user_id userId, lat, lng, real_lat realLat, real_lng realLng, locate_type locateType from corgi_user_position where user_id = #{userId}
select user_id userId, lat, lng, real_lng realLng, locate_type locateType,uptime from corgi_user_position limit #{start}, #{size}

select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, p.locate_type locateType, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.role role, d.hide_role hideRole, d.group `group`, d.hide_group `hideGroup`, d.hide_prefer_group `hidePreferGroup`, d.con con, d.relation, d.check_status checkStatus, l.im_id imId from corgi_user_position p join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = d.user_id where p.user_id in ${inValue}
select count(1) from corgi_user_position where uptime >= #{beginTime} and uptime <= #{endTime}
select count(1) from corgi_user_position p left join corgi_user_login l on p.user_id = l.id where p.uptime >= #{time} and l.ctime like concat(#{date},'%')
select count(1) from corgi_user_login where ctime like concat(#{date},'%')

select distinct d.user_id from corgi_user_detail d
left join corgi_prefer_group g on g.user_id = d.user_id
where d.user_id in ${userId}
and d.role in ${role} and d.hide_role != '1'
and d.group in ${group} and d.hide_group != '1'
and g.group in ${preferGroup} and d.hide_prefer_group != '1'
and not EXISTS (select 1 from corgi_blacklist where (user_id = #{filterId} and black_id = d.user_id) or(user_id = d.user_id and black_id = #{filterId}))
